source_snapshot.items: NVQual - PCIE Link Disable and Enable Test
source_snapshot.procedure: Perform 10,000 disable/enable cycles on all PCIe bridges with endpoints.
source_snapshot.criteria: Information readable/no spelling error; FW Version correct.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; guesses `nvqual pcie_link_de` and treats it as generic.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: RPUC/CHANGED/CRITICAL; unbounded link removal can take down host or corrupt active I/O.

historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Requires allowlist, I/O protection, cycle oracle and recovery.
historical_reviews.related_cases: Equalization, secondary-bus reset and retrain loops are distinct mechanisms.

original_test_intent: Disable and re-enable each approved PCIe link 10,000 times and prove endpoints disappear and re-enumerate correctly with expected link state, drivers and no cumulative errors or data corruption.
original_method: Pin vendor module/config; map bridge/link/endpoint allowlist and exclude shared critical paths; baseline link/driver/AER/I/O; approve cycle timing and removal/recovery oracle; drain/unmount services; run monitored cycles with first-failure stop; restore endpoints/services and confirm data/system health.
manual_activity: Platform owner approves link targets and downtime; storage/network operators quiesce dependent I/O and own recovery.
safety_requirements: Exclude boot/storage/management paths unless isolated and approved
Stop on first failed re-enumeration, I/O, AER or management event

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The guessed link_de token has no target, cycle or recovery definition.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use only the pinned vendor module on explicitly allowlisted links with per-cycle disappearance and recovery verification.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The literal 10,000 disable/enable loops are retained, not replaced by a read-only link check.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Record pre-disable presence, expected absence, post-enable identity/speed/width/driver state and error deltas for every cycle.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds safe physical scope, objective re-enumeration and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Firmware/readability cannot validate repeated link removal.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Removing a shared link can corrupt active I/O, lose management connectivity or leave drivers wedged.

project_override_considerations: Topology owner defines which paths are independently recoverable and whether 10,000 applies per link or across the suite.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure mandates 10,000 disruptive link cycles; Criteria only check readable text and firmware.

blocked_analysis.analysis: A safe isolated allowlist can make execution possible; unsafe or ambiguous paths are per-run hard blocks.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Compatibility row312 Wistron-NV GPU-00305-V003: approve exact link-cycle module/config, safe bridge/link/endpoint allowlist, 10,000-cycle timing, disappearance/re-enumeration/speed/width/error/data-integrity oracle and recovery; map or replace unrelated Criteria.

review_improvement: Preserves repeated link-removal coverage while preventing indiscriminate disruption of critical PCIe hierarchies.
independent_technical_reasoning: A link disable is more disruptive than retraining because the endpoint may vanish from configuration space and its driver may tear down state. Each cycle must prove identity-correct re-enumeration before continuing, especially for multifunction or shared-bridge devices.
